verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation that Zapier generates or edits a Zap workflow from a natural-language prompt. The closest items cover other capabilities: Copilot helps create agents rather than workflows, MCP lets an external AI execute individual actions from plain language, Canvas maps processes, and AI writes troubleshooting instructions. None of these is prompt-to-workflow generation or editing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can generate or edit a workflow from a natural-language prompt
